segments: This point David is anointed king and
there was a beat between Judah and the
tribes of Epha. The book of 2 Samuel
chapter 19:41. And behold, all the men
of Israel came to the king and said unto
the king, "Why have our brother the men
of Judah stolen thee away and have
brought the king and his household and
all David's men with him over Jordan?"
Ephen the northern kingdom is asking
Judah, "Why'd you take David from us?
He's our king, too." And all the men of
Judah answered the men of Israel because
the king is near of kin to us. We're the
same tribe. Go ahead. Wherefore then be
ye angry for this matter? Have we eaten
at all of the king's cost? Or have ye
given us any gift? And the men of Israel
answered the men of Judah, and said, We
have 10 parts in the king, and we have
also more right in David than ye. He
should be a king over us more, and he
should be a king over you, cuz there's
more of us than you. So remember, during
this time, there was no split. Over
time, there was a rivalry between Judah
and Ephraim. They said, "We have 10
parts. If you include Dan, we have 10
parts. There's more of us than you. We
have more land than you. There's more of
us than you. So there was that rift,
that division that Judah and Ephraim had
among themselves even at this time.
